title: Flagged auth, location and protected-invite composition
implementation: Moved the existing login screen/controller into AuthLoginScreen and left the existing route as a thin default export.
Added oorva_auth_ux composition branches to S01, S02, S03, S39, S48 and AddressEditorSheet; the effective feature hook keeps the oorva_brand parent gate.
Used auth identity on auth/location surfaces and protectedInvite identity outside the protected-invite composition branch.
Kept auth, location, invite claim, payment, amount, authorization and return-target controllers in place; no server or money-safety paths changed.
Initialized AddressEditor drafts when the editor opens or its owner changes, not when its location pin object refreshes.
